text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that's—

While walking through the city with Calstone Light O,
she spotted a cosmetics shop and came to a stop.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
May I make a quick stop?
I have run out of skincare products.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The "Neige" skin lotion is...
not here, it seems.
choice_data_list: Why won't any other toner do?
Can't you use a different toner?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it really has to be that one.
It's a brand I've been using for a very long time.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me.
Regarding the "Neige" toner...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
She had merely moved to a different spot.
I'm glad we found her.
choice_data_list: You're pretty particular about your care products, huh.
You're pretty particular about your care products, aren't you.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Skincare is essential
if I want to become the fastest.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I feel like silky-smooth skin reduces friction.
And that means I can run faster.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
That's why proper grooming is essential.
I can never slack off on it.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Gently, as if wrapping it within the palms of the hands—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Kh, this turtle-like speed...
I want to scrub! I want to paint it quickly!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's all for silky-smooth skin!
Endure it, me...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Your rival is always yourself.
Skincare is a daily battle, after all."
choice_data_list: Taking care of your skin is tough, huh……
Taking care of your skin is tough, isn't it……

text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it, I've been troubled by rough skin lately too.
Maybe it'll improve if I take proper care of it.
choice_data_list: Do you have any recommended grooming products?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
Your skin is guaranteed to become silky smooth.
You have my word.

Afterward, I decided to let her try out the skincare products
she had bought on a bench right in front of the store.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Here, please take this hand cream.
I recommend it because it isn't sticky after applying.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
please hold out your hand.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
First, rub the cream in all over.
Like this, nice and smooth—
Saying that, Calstone Light O took my hand and directly started applying the cream.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The trick is to apply it carefully, as if giving a massage.
Gently work it into the skin.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The sides of your hands get chapped easily, so don't forget them.
Make sure to moisturize thoroughly.

Slowly, softly.
A comforting warmth spreads across the back of my hand.

It felt terribly ticklish, but...
each gentle stroke of her fingers seemed to convey her sincere dedication.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, all done.
How does this moistness feel?
choice_data_list: Yeah, this should help heal your rough hands too.
Yeah, with this, my chapped hands should get better too.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad you liked it.
Not only will it leave your skin silky smooth, of course, but—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I also recommend this scent.

And Calstone Light O brought her hand
close to her face, sniffing it repeatedly.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"...It's this scent.
The sweet smell of hand cream."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Now you're matching with me, Trainer.

So she speaks gently.
That must be how much
she loves this hand cream.
choice_data_list: I can really feel your dedication to skincare!
Tell me about some other care products next time.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Yes. Because it's to draw closer to 'top speed.'

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
My skin, naturally.
My arms and tummy are in tip-top shape, too.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Of course my legs too.
Look, they're this—
choice_data_list: Wah! You don't have to show it here!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hm, I see.
I was confident in my maintenance. How disappointing.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Goodness!
You're still striving for even smoother skin?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
You really wanted to become that fast, didn't you?
I had no idea.
choice_data_list: Huh? That's not what I meant—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
No, words are unnecessary.
What we need is skincare
to become the fastest!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Next, I shall teach you about moisturizing milk.
Let us become fast together, Trainer!
